images.screen: A — 가을 침입: 영속 덱의 카드를 쓰며 닳는 순간 (Autumn siege, playing worn cards)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A roguelike deckbuilder battle screen in 16:9, side-on stage composition: on the left a snow-capped stone gatehouse with an iron portcullis and a single hanging oil lantern, the only warm orange light in the whole frame, spilling a small amber pool onto the stones and snow. To the right, on a misty moonlit snowfield, pale frost creatures advance: a spiky frost wolf, a hulking glowing avalanche bear, an ice crow, each with a small dark intent plate showing a sword icon and a number. Bottom third: a fanned hand of five steel-blue card frames with diamond cost gems, frosted line-art glyphs (sword, shield, flame, wrench, wheat sickle) and, on every card, a segmented durability bar where intact segments glow snow-white and used segments are dull rust brown. Right side: a dark storehouse panel listing the persistent deck with tiny wear bars. Palette 95% cold blue-grey, high contrast, falling snow, film grain, vignette. Korean UI: "겨울 요새", "가을 침입", "남은 횟수 1 / 3", "턴 종료".

images.screen: B — 겨울 장수: 마지막 한 번 남은 카드로 끝내는 보스전 (Winter boss, spending the last use)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Climax of a winter-siege deckbuilder, 16:9. Heavy blizzard at night; the fortress gate on the left is cracked, a broken portcullis bar, the lone lantern guttering low and tilted, its tiny orange flame the only warm color. Center: a towering Winter Captain boss in an antlered iron helm, white fur mantle, and a translucent ice greatsword, rim-lit cold white, with an intent plate reading a ramp-up arrow. Below the boss a thin health bar nearly empty. Bottom: four worn steel-blue cards with cracked frost faces and mostly rust-colored durability bars; the center card, a wheat-sickle harvest card with one segment left, is lifted and glowing with a white lethal callout tag above it. Right panel: a winter-wear forecast listing every stored card losing one use, dashed outlines on the ones that will break forever. Moody, desaturated, dense snow particles, deep vignette, subtle grain. Korean UI: "겨울 · 보스", "치명 16 ≥ 14", "겨울나기 예고". Text constraints: the torch card is spelled exactly "횃불" (never "햇불") both on the card and in the forecast list; its durability bar shows exactly one lit segment, matching "1 → 0".
